DXC issue #2530 -- Array bound with static const variable
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/2530

WHAT TO LOOK FOR

Compare the FXC pane against the two DXC panes. Same shader, and an
array bound whose value is 1.

FXC (ps_5_0) accepts it and emits a shader.

Both DXC versions reject it:

    error: variable length arrays are not supported in HLSL

The bound is knowable at compile time -- it is the constant 1 with a
float-to-uint conversion in front of it. DXC inherits clang's C++03
integer-constant-expression rules, which accept a cast applied to a
float *literal* but not one applied to a const float *variable*, so
uint(ARRAY_SIZE) is not a constant expression and the declaration
becomes a variable-length array.

Two one-line edits show where the line is drawn, neither of which
changes the array or its size:

    float array[uint(1.0f)]        compiles -- operand is a literal
    static const uint ARRAY_SIZE   compiles -- no conversion at all

The issue body's second case, static const uint N = (uint)ARRAY_SIZE
used as the bound, fails the same way: N's initializer is not a
constant expression, so N cannot be used in one either.
